mapper.insert: INSERT INTO car_auth ( owner_id, vehicle_type, current_type, car_brand, car_type, max_charge_voltage, max_charge_current, max_charge_power, battery_capacity, discharge_power, `range`, vehicle_number, auth_status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{ownerId}, #{vehicleType}, #{currentType}, #{carBrand}, #{carType}, #{maxChargeVoltage}, #{maxChargeCurrent}, #{maxChargePower}, #{batteryCapacity}, #{dischargePower}, #{range}, #{vehicleNumber}, 1, -- 审核中状态 0, -- 未删除 NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM car_auth WHERE owner_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, owner_id AS ownerId, vehicle_type AS vehicleType, car_brand AS carBrand, car_type AS carType, current_type AS currentType, max_charge_voltage AS maxChargeVoltage, max_charge_current AS maxChargeCurrent, max_charge_power AS maxChargePower, battery_capacity AS batteryCapacity, discharge_power AS dischargePower, `range`, auth_status AS authStatus, vehicle_number AS vehicleNumber, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM car_auth WHERE owner_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE car_auth SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE owner_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
